remarks: Stunning brand new designer renovation of waterfront two-bedroom, two bath condominium at Harbor House in coveted Shippan.  Light and airy open concept living area with balcony to breathtaking harbor and city views. These magnificent views may also be enjoyed from your primary bedroom! Renovation boasts gleaming white oak floors throughout, brand new kitchen opened to capitalize on views, exquisitely renovated en-suite primary bath and second full bath, new interior doors, hardware, recessed lighting in all rooms, plus many gorgeous details added throughout.  Enjoy the sun setting over the harbor from the living area and primary bedroom. Foyer and second bedroom offer distant water view. Just minutes to vibrant downtown, restaurants, nightlife, beach, fitness clubs, train station and places of worship. Stacked washer/dryer in unit. Ample closet space. Stroll along marina on lovely park-like grounds. Assigned garage space and storage unit.  Pet friendly.
